coverage.finding: Folio label '18' with superscript b and a point beneath, at the top left (native c.[395,335,110,90]). The candidate's literal '18ᵇ.' matches the image. The dot/underdot ambiguity is correctly kept.

Single faint pencil line at native y≈1180–1260, x≈420–1900, reading 'ff.1-10. Scribe Kālīprasāda Dāsa[?]. RLM, II, 620.' It has no shelfmark or heading. It is correctly treated as an annotation, not a holding. The final vowel of 'Dāsa' appears to carry a stroke that may be a macron. This is now flagged as an uncertainty.

Oval-enclosed pencil note at native c.[2010,2900,740,190]. 'Corrupt. metre & text' is legible; the ampersand-like sign is read as '&'. The first word is not securely legible and is correctly bracketed as uncertain. The note is level with the fol. 19 note 'ff 1-11, in 10+162 verses…' under d. 341(8). No connecting line is visible.

Hooked pencil line at native x≈2989–3214, y≈1200–1215. It runs up to and slightly across the gutter (gutter c.x 3180–3195). It matches the dash seen at the left edge of the fol. 19 overview, opposite c. 369 (6)ᶜ. The candidate correctly records it as attachment evidence for b002, at probable certainty only.
Faint 'a/' (or 'd/') at native c.[2754,2488,70,85]. Correctly recorded as an uncertain mark.

Pencil 'm' (apparently with a point below) followed by a long slash, at native c.[3000,2938,75,180]. It lies physically on fol. 18b near the gutter and corresponds to the 'm/' visible at the left edge of the fol. 19 overview. Correctly recorded.

Faint '?/' or '7/' with a point below, at native c.[2924,3245,70,165]. A further faint curved stroke lies lower left (native c.[2844,3330,60,110]); it may be a separate 'a/'-like mark. The candidate folds this stroke into r006 as an annotation, which is acceptable, but whether it is a separate mark is unresolved.

changes.reason: Native tile 1 shows a superscript stroke over the final letter of 'Dāsa'. This possible diacritic should be recorded as uncertain rather than silently omitted.

unresolved.issue: Attachment of the scribe/extent note to fol. 19 c. 369 (6)ᶜ Ātmanātmaviveka is supported only by the hooked line at the same height. It is not secure.
unresolved.next_check: Compare with how other facing-page additions in this volume use hooked lines toward the opposite page.

unresolved.issue: The first word of the oval note is illegible or uncertain. Its attachment to fol. 19 d. 341(8) or d. 341(4) rests on vertical level only.
unresolved.next_check: Higher-contrast imaging of the first word; compare with the titles of the d. 341 entries on fol. 19.

unresolved.issue: It is unclear whether the lower-left faint stroke below '?/' is a separate mark (possibly 'a/') or part of the same mark.
unresolved.next_check: Enhanced view of native region c.[2830,3220,200,240].

unresolved.issue: The meaning of the letter-plus-slash marks near the gutter is unknown.
unresolved.next_check: Look for similar mark series on other verso pages.

review.boundary_review: The gutter lies at about native x 3180–3195. Everything to its right (e. 10…, e. 1…, d. 5…, √c. 3…, d., f. 4, d., e., du…, √d., ff 1-11 … shorter vers…, √d., e., e., d.-) belongs to fol. 19 and is correctly excluded. The b901 hook slightly crosses the gutter but originates on 18b. The marks b903 and b904 lie on 18b although they are visible on the fol. 19 overview edge. Mirrored faint writing across the page is show-through and is not transcribed. Attachments remain probable or uncertain only.

region_review.top: Folio label 18ᵇ only. There is a speck near the gutter at about native (3149,550); it is not text.
region_review.middle: b002 line with hook b901. b902 'a/'. b003 oval note with b903 'm/'. b904 '?/' plus a lower faint stroke. The rest is ruled lines with show-through.
region_review.bottom: Reviewed in native tiles 5 and 6. No writing; only faint show-through and specks.
region_review.left_margin: A tiny pencil tick at about native (325,1420) is non-textual. It is noted in the candidate's page_annotations and has no block ID.
region_review.right_margin: The gutter-side marks b901, b903 and b904 are represented. Fol. 19 content beyond the gutter is excluded.
region_review.interlinear: No interlinear additions, cancellations or corrections were found on this page.
